title: Foundations: code and maths
summary: Set up your tools, learn just enough Python to read and write the project's code, and pick up the three pieces of maths the whole project runs on: averages, exponential decay and geometric sums.
deliverable: All five checkpoints passing in the browser

title: APIs, Gemini and your first chatbot
summary: Talk to a large language model from your own code, give it a memory on disk, and wrap it in a chat interface.
deliverable: A Streamlit chatbot that saves every chat to JSON

title: The agentic chatbot
summary: Turn a passive chatbot into an agent: it remembers the conversation, decides on its own when to quiz you, grades you in a format code can use, and can teach Socratically.

title: Reinforcement learning from scratch
summary: Learn by trial, error and reward: bandits, exploration, returns and Q-learning, each implemented by you and run in the browser.

title: Spaced repetition: rules vs RL
summary: Model forgetting, build a simulated student, beat the classic Leitner schedule with a Q-learning agent, and watch a badly designed reward make it cheat.
deliverable: Scheduler checkpoints and a one-page comparison

title: RL inside the live tutor
summary: Close the loop: the tutor quizzes you when the agent says so, Gemini grades you, and every grade keeps training the agent. Then benchmark, demo and report.
deliverable: End-term tutor, Cup entry, demo and report
